Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating sports pool boards, bracket pools, and fantasy sports leagues.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to regulating sports pool boards, bracket pools,and fantasy sports leagues; and amending RCW 9.46.0335.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9.46.0335 and 1987 c 4 s 31 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((The legislature hereby authorizes)) (1) Any person, association,or organization ((to)) may conduct sports pool boards, bracket pools,and fantasy sports leagues without a license to do so from thecommission but only when the outcome of which is dependent upon thescore, or scores, of a certain athletic contest or upon the outcome ofa contest or event not within the control of those engaged in thesports pool board, bracket pool, or fantasy sports league and which isconducted ((only)) in the following manner: (((1))) (a) All money paid by entrants to enter the pool less taxesis paid out as the prize or prizes to those persons having the winningscore or scores from the subject athletic contest or other outcome uponwhich the pool or sports league is based; and (b) The sports pool board, bracket pool, or fantasy sports league p. 1 HB 3134records are available for inspection by any person participating, thecommission, or by any law enforcement agency upon demand at all timesbefore prize payment; and (c) The person or organization conducting the sports pool board,bracket pool, or fantasy sports league is conducting no other similaractivity on the same event; and (d) The sports pool board, bracket pool, or fantasy sports leagueconforms to the requirements of this chapter and any rules adoptedunder this chapter; and (e) The total amount of wagers placed by all entrants in the sportspool board, bracket pool, or fantasy sports league does not exceed onehundred dollars. (2) In addition to the requirements of subsection (1) of thissection, sports pool boards must comply with the following: (a) A board or piece of paper is divided into one hundred equalsquares, each of which constitutes a chance to win in the ((sports))pool and each of which is offered directly to prospective contestantsat one dollar or less; and (((2))) (b) The purchaser of each chance or square signs his or hername on the face of each square or chance he or she purchases; and (((3) At some time not later than prior to the start of the subjectathletic contest)) (c) The pool ((is)) must be closed before the startof the subject athletic contest and no further chances in the pool((are)) may be sold; and (((4))) (d) After the pool is closed a prospective score isassigned by random drawing to each square((; (5) All money paid by entrants to enter the pool less taxes is paidout as the prize or prizes to those persons holding squares assignedthe winning score or scores from the subject athletic contest; (6) The sports pool board is available for inspection by any personpurchasing a chance thereon, the commission, or by any law enforcementagency upon demand at all times prior to the payment of the prize; (7) The person or organization conducting the pool is conducting noother sports pool on the same athletic event; and (8) The sports pool conforms to any rules and regulations of thecommission applicable thereto)).
